text:
Type: five-arm chandelier
Use: light over a dining table or room center; dining room, living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: dark bronze metal, frosted glass shades, chain suspension
Colors: dark bronze black, frosted white
Shape: five curved scrolled arms with upturned bell shades, central column, hangs on a chain from round canopy, medium size, open
Feel: classic, cozy, welcoming
Goes with: dark or warm wood, cream walls, oil-rubbed bronze; traditional or farmhouse dining rooms
